notes.title: Rusty's Retirement x Vampire Survivors!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this update is pretty exciting, and it's an actual real update, [b]not an April Fools joke![/b]

(I also have some big life news to share but I'll briefly touch on that towards the end)

Some of you may have heard of the smash hit indie, Vampire Survivors. Well, the kind folks over at Poncle were playing my silly little game, and had the idea of "What if Poe retired?". They reached out, I loved the idea, and we got to work on it!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Introducing the new Vampire Survivor-themed map![/h2]

In other words, [strike]Rusty's[/strike] Poe's Retirement!

[previewyoutube=yO2hj2jsjd4;full][/previewyoutube]
This new map has complete character swaps, new houses, and a brand-new mechanic; [b]plant garlic to prevent bats from stealing your crops[/b].

Aside from the obvious crossover reskin, I wanted to introduce a new (and slightly different) mechanic to the game so that existing players would also have something new to enjoy. 

Bats will spawn from the edges of the map and try to steal your crops. You can defeat enemy bats by planting garlic that does damage over time (just like in VS). After defeating a bat, they will drop a gem which can then be picked up by nearby characters for extra spare parts or biofuel. As you expand the map, the bats also get stronger.

All of this can be toggled off if you are looking for a more casual experience!

[h3]Create a new savefile to access the new farm![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/fb8b37132220dc5058f093ca773d2743d8bf5ddd.png[/img]

It was fun to experiment with some light combat while trying to keep things feeling like the original game. This collaboration has opened the doors to more opportunities, so you can expect a few more of these crossovers with other games to come. That leads me to my next topic:

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Mini Morris has entered the chat[/h2]
[expand type=details]
Yup, I'm a Dad now! This little fella only just recently spawned into the world and he is such a bundle of joy. I feel blessed to have the opportunity to stay at home and help Mommy Morris raise the baby. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/aaf5f57d2a226c5299c52b209eb30787b729b783.png[/img]

These crossovers feel like the best fit right now as we navigate these first few months of parenthood. I can bring more content to the game (in the form of skins), they also help bring new players, and I can experiment with different ideas without worrying if they fit into the overall vision that I have for the game.

[h2]The future[/h2]

I still have plans to expand the base game, and to add more late game content, which seems to be the thing that most people have been requesting lately. While I don't want to promise anything specific, I have been toying around with mining, conveyor belts, and an electrical system that runs off of biofuel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/612161d5a186c36ba98c819f6c464f81747b3937.gif[/img]
[/expand]
[hr][/hr]

That's all for today folks, 
Happy April Fools' Day, and I hope you enjoy the [b]Rusty's Retirement x Vampire Survivor[/b] crossover!

notes.title: Build 1.0.19
notes.content:
Hey folks,

 Here are some minor bug fixes that have appeared with the new influx of players from the Daily Deal and the Idler Fest that is currently running on Steam.

[list]
[*] Setting a massive Taskbar height would launch the game completely off the screen. This should be fixed now (I accidentally broke it with the Winter update :sigh_haiku: )

notes.title: Build 1.0.17
notes.content:
Hey folks, here are a few fixes for issues that appeared in the new Winter update:

[list]
[*] Moving a chicken coop or a pet house would contribute to the "Cluck, cluck" and "Have a few pets" achievements. It should be fixed now!
[*] The !plant command for the Twitch integration was causing viewer bots to plant "ghost" crops. This should also be fixed!
[/list]
Some of you have raised concerns about unlocking chips for all crops (and its respective achievement "Heavily modified crops"). I'm gathering feedback and I will most likely apply some balance changes in the upcoming days.

Currently, the shop will try to give you chips for your most recently unlocked crops, because these are more beneficial when it comes to earning biofuel and unlocking subsequent crops. Once you've unlocked all the crops, the chips are then completely randomized, giving you more chances of getting chips for older crops.

I'm closely monitoring the balancing of the shop and I will keep you posted on any updates ːorange_heartː


[b]Update![/b] Chip shop balances can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2666510/view/571491226772046720

[hr][/hr]
Lastly, how does Splunk feel with the new changes? Does he feel more productive?

Thanks!

notes.title: New Winter update now available!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Before we get started, I wanted to take a moment and express my gratitude to everyone who has played the game. Your love and support for Rusty has completely changed my life. This game definitely feels like a life achievement. With that said...

I am happy to announce that the [b]first major content update for Rusty's Retirement is out now!![/b]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/0eb7b081dc7d5f175dad4564f787af9a404262a3.gif[/img][h3]- New map: Snowy Fields[/h3]
Those who have passed the first three maps can now access the Snowy Fields map where bots consume more biofuel to survive the harsh winter conditions. Peak-cozy winter vibes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/393f3caa9aa390d3225c481a38b81bcd33255719.gif[/img]
[h3]- New animal: Deer[/h3]
As you expand your farm, deer will spawn on the new Snowy Fields map and the old Blossom Forest map.

[h3]- New decorations: Christmas decorations[/h3]
Since it is the season, a winter update wouldn't be complete without some new Christmas-themed decor!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/e70f3e74abf97669170866da383b8c3d4766227e.gif[/img]
[h3]- New character: Reaper's Outpost[/h3]
Building an outpost will offer a spot for Reapers to come and park on your farm. Reapers travel between farms looking to sell their crop enhancement chips. If you don't like any of the chips they are selling, you can reroll what's in store.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/3a5e3fe934094bc083e2e9d92b33d0715f4d63a6.gif[/img]
[h3]- New animal: Cats and Dogs[/h3]
You can now unlock different types of cats and dogs to help out around the farm. They will occasionally follow Rusty around, sleep, and help with harvesting crops. Each cat and dog has their own special 2x2 pet house assigned to them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/6749090fb85b6fa8ca3ae3170ac12079fd61daea.gif[/img]
[h3]- New animal: Chickens[/h3]
You can also unlock chickens! Build a Chicken Nest and watch them peck away at any pests lurking in the crop's soil. This pest-removal process helps improve a crop's harvest by +1.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/9d97d83524a2ca3e859d3927f2a1eac979f4dc6a.png[/img]
[h3]- New polish: Characters talk to each other[/h3]
This one is pretty self-explanatory, if an npc isn't doing much, they will interact with each other.

[h3]- New polish: Pinion's Goldcrests[/h3]
In my previous game, Pinion was in charge of the Goldcrest mechanical birds, which were part of a banking system. Now they appear on top of his house and fly around the farm randomly sitting on top of buildings.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/a4140a6f5ae7c6b9a71d8271f594d298d8c77889.png[/img]
[h3]- New polish: Rusty wears a Christmas hat[/h3]
Pretty simple, Rusty will wear a Christmas hat throughout the duration of December. On January 1st, they will put it away and wait for next year.


[h2]What's improved?[/h2]
[list]
[*] New achievements have been added to support the new content!
[*] Slate’s fossil cap has been increased. New formula = maximum needed fossils * 3.
[*] Fertilizer now has a cap of 999 which should stop animals from endlessly consuming crops and pooping.
[*] Splunk will now seed crop patches that are 75% empty and he will also pick the closest crop patch instead of randomly choosing one across the farm.
[*] Bulbhives have been renamed to Beehives to avoid confusion between the two words.
[*] Beehives also show a line between the hive and Forbic indicating that the character is coming to harvest the biofuel.
[*] Beehives also need to be harvested less often. Don't worry though, they still accumulate the same amount of biofuel as before.
[*] Disabling a bot will now make said bot return to their station after they have completed their ongoing task.
[*] Added 8 new crops to unlock, plus three new giant crops.
[/list]

[h2]What's fixed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a green dot would appear on top of the crop/berry tabs at the beginning of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug which would cause Splunk to freeze if you placed a 'Don't seed' sign right before he starts planting seeds.
[*] Fixed a bug where disabled bots would accidentally take a 'task' after loading the game.
[*] Added a second method of getting an OAuth token in the Twitch Integration guide.
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause Twitch viewer bots to freeze when planting seeds on a 'Don't seed' crop patch.
[*] Added a bit of leeway to the Architect achievement.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

That's it for today, I hope you enjoy the new content, and thank you for your continued support! :orange_heart:

notes.title: Nominate Rusty's Retirement in the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[h2]What are the Steam Awards?[/h2]

The Steam Awards is an annual event where players nominate and vote for their favorite games in various categories, such as "Labor of Love" or "Best Game You Suck At".

Winners are chosen entirely by the community. Nominations take place during the autumn sale and voting during the winter sale.

[h2]Why nominate Rusty's Retirement?[/h2]

I've submitted Rusty's Retirement for the [b]Most Innovative Gameplay Award[/b] for its design of sitting at the bottom of your screen while you do other things.

Since the game's inception, people really resonate with the idea, and it makes me happy to see the game currently sitting on a 96% overwhelmingly positive rating on Steam.

It's a game I am proud to have made, and I feel like it would be cool to get a nomination in the innovation category, mainly for allowing players to multitask while playing.

In the last few months, I've also even seen a bunch of new games pop up following a similar design. To me, this is the highest form of appraisal, and to have essentially created a new genre is mind-blowing.
Here are a few worth checking out: My Little Life, Whimside, and Desktop Cat Cafe.

[b]Please nominate Rusty's Retirement in the Steam Awards![/b] It would mean the world to me ːorange_heartː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/6634dfe98e04def66cb34b5bc76a8192b9f5b8eb.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2]In case you missed it:[/h2]

I've been working on a new [b]Winter update[/b] that will include a new snowy map, new crops, and a brand-new character. The plan is to release it at the middle of December so more info soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/0eb7b081dc7d5f175dad4564f787af9a404262a3.gif[/img]

Thank you for everything, and please spare a nomination for Rusty! ːorange_heartː

notes.title: Work-in-progress
notes.content:
Hey folks,

I thought I'd give a little life update post-release and what plans I have for the game.

[h2]Personal life[/h2]

As some of you may already know, I made this game in a record-breaking 6 months. Steam planned a farming festival for April 2024 and I knew that I had to release the game during that timeframe to increase the game's chances of success - luckily it paid off!

With that said, I pushed myself quite hard during those months. After the release, I fixed bugs for a month, I made a "Quality-of-Life" update, and then I decided to take it easy after that.

I spent time with friends and family, I went to different game conventions (Gamescom and Tokyo Games Show) and met with a bunch of you face-to-face. I had many great talks with other developers and I hope I was able to help provide some insight on what worked for me when making/selling games.

Lately though, I've been brainstorming new ideas for the game, and testing out a few of the new ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/0eb7b081dc7d5f175dad4564f787af9a404262a3.gif[/img]
[h2]New Winter Update! (work-in-progress)[/h2]

That's right, I'm currently working on a new Winter update that will include a new snowy map, new crops, and a brand-new character. The current plan is to release this new update at the beginning of December so be on the lookout for more info!

I have other ideas for future updates but these still need to be explored and worked on. I need to see if they are viable and whether they fit with the rest of the game.

Thank you for everything!

notes.title: Build 1.0.15
notes.content:
Hey folks, here are a few fixes for issues that appeared in the new QoL update:

[list]
[*] Zoom in and out was incrementing the camera's scale by multiples of 2 - it is fixed and will now increment by 1 as intended.
[*] Moving the camera in vertical mode with the arrow keys was also zooming in and out due to some old code still being active, this has also been fixed now.
[*] Fixed some weird camera clamping issues that were causing the camera to jump around.
[*] Trackpad scrolling only works in horizontal mode for now until I fix some of the issues that popped up on vertical farms.
[*] Golden pumpkins were popping with one click when they should have been popping after 36 clicks. Now they pop after 36 clicks and this should help prevent harvesting giant golden pumpkins by accident.
[*] Splunk’s new ‘Do not seed’ sign should be fixed.
[*] Moving houses or buildings on top of themselves would free up the land beneath them allowing people to build where they shouldn't be able to. This has been fixed because it was causing all sorts of bugs and issues.
[*] And... Estonian has been added to the game as a language option! (let's hope it doesn't break anything)
[/list]
Thank you, and it's great to see that people are happy with the new update!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Build 1.0.15+ hotfix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moving crop patches would block the ability to plant seeds on top of them and sometimes you could even build on them. Fixed!
[*] Disabling and enabling bot stations should now save correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

I’m happy to finally add some quality-of-life changes to the game! Thank you for your patience, I know this took a little longer than expected, and it’s because I took a well-deserved 2-week break from the game to recharge my own biofuel-filled batteries.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/46a4654debfbd72b944328105cab6c35bee366a8.gif[/img]
[h3]1. Move buildings one tile![/h3]
So many people reached out to me to ask if I could add the functionality allowing you to move buildings one tile across. I even had personal friends reach out to me to ask for this feature - so yeah, it was a big one!

You can also move bushes and decorations now.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/b6be23a8c36c09a8416ab056b6d5ecde80abc6fc.gif[/img]
[h3]2. Move animals (and destroy empty feeders)[/h3] 
I’ve added a new button to the ‘Animal tab’ that allows you to move animals between feeder slots. Also, if a feeder is completely empty then you can now destroy it if you so wish. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/e2fe1b0a4f612fc2e5d447ca976355b3545086fa.gif[/img]
[h3]3. Improved bees and butterflies[/h3]
Bees received a rework and I will briefly explain how they now function. All bees on the farm are evenly spread across beehives and they will only visit bushes in range of their designated beehive. If you place a new beehive, bees will automatically migrate to the new hive. Beehives still produce biofuel, and berry bushes now have a maximum capacity of bees that can visit at the same time.

Butterflies essentially work the same way minus the capability to produce biofuel at a beehive.


[h3]Those are the 3 main big things,[/h3] 
but I’ve also added a bunch of small features too:
[list]
[*] You can now use the arrow keys to move around the farm. Tip: hold down Shift + Arrow key to speed up the camera panning.
[*] You can also use the trackpad scroll to move around the map.
[*] Golden Metal Pumpkins are now harvestable. You just have to click on it a lot to pop it.
[*] You can disable/enable bot stations. This will prevent the bot from recharging and consuming biofuel. This is a bit of an advanced feature so I decided not to make the button too obvious.
[*] Bot biofuel consumption after upgrading has been lowered slightly. Capacity upgrades still add 1 biofuel but speed upgrades now add 0.5 biofuel (the total is rounded).
[*] Splunk has a new sign available in the shop. The ‘Do not seed’ sign will prevent Splunk from planting crops.
[*] Splunk will now plant on empty crop patches that are occupied by a giant crop or a fossil.
[*] The inspect function will now show you how many waterings a crop still needs and how many harvests a crop has remaining.
[*] I have also added a notification icon to some of the tabs, so you can quickly see if you have anything new to unlock without having to cycle through all the tabs all the time.
[*] And lastly, I gave the remove crops button a new icon so it wouldn’t be confused with the demolish buildings icon.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/eaeb5edb39be025a6f2dd114bc195887ea18f259.png[/img]
[code](The green light next to the recharge cost is the disable/enable button - very subtle)[/code]

[h3]Performance improvements[/h3]
Thank you everyone for helping me to test the performance branch. To minimize the impact on existing players who are enjoying the game without any problems, we’ve added a new dropdown under Settings > Graphics, where you can choose how the transparent background is rendered.

[list]
[*] Colorkey - sets the background color to black and then converts any black pixels into transparent ones.
[*] Alpha - sets the background transparent and is overall more performant but the only drawback is that it does not work well with overlays.
[*] Green screen - sets the background color to green and converts any green pixels into transparent ones. This setting is mainly used by streamers.
[/list]
Most people will remain using Colorkey but if you are having performance issues with frame rate, then please try switching to Alpha. In the future, we hope to add a plain ‘windowed mode’ which is a failsafe for everything that could possibly go wrong and it will probably benefit Linux users as a bonus.

---

That's it for today folks, I very much look forward to developing new content for the game now that this stuff is out of the way. As always, don't hesitate to let me know if there are any bugs or any features you'd like to see improved/added ːorange_heartː

notes.title: Build 1.0.13
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Achievements will try to trigger more often. If not, then please check that Steam is connected otherwise they will not trigger.
[*] Backups of your savefiles will happen automatically every minute. I hope this will help in case a savefile gets corrupted.
[*] Made some improvements to the Japanese and Chinese-simplified translations.
[*] Added credits for the translators
[/list]

[h2]Looking for people to test the performance beta branch![/h2]

We plan to switch to a different transparency method to improve performance on high-resolution and high-refresh rate monitors. This new method now looks at transparent pixels and keeps them transparent. The previous transparency method looked for pixels with the color key (#000000 black or #00ff00 green) and then turned them transparent resulting in a poor frame rate.

If you’re interested in testing the new method, then please enable the performance test branch under Betas (password: performancetest). You’ll know if you’re playing the right build because in the game it will say 1.0.13++.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/610c8f776e0c0ba03f21de231802bb44985b8398.png[/img]
Please test as many things as possible, such as switching monitors, changing the taskbar/sidebar size, etc. Remember that if the game gets stuck on a weird resolution, you can use R or T to reset the camera and UI. And I encourage non-big-monitor-people to try it as well. You can join the discord server to leave feedback: [url=https://discord.gg/PbshYaU8Mr]https://discord.gg/PbshYaU8Mr[/url]

Known issue: Overlays on top of Rusty’s Retirement become translucent so please refrain from using overlays on the game.

I look forward to your feedback, thank you!

notes.title: Build 1.0.12
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Here are some more fixes and additions to the game:

[list]
[*] Fixed: Echo no longer gets stuck if you delete the bot station while he is working on it.
[*] Fixed: Move/build building no longer checks the mouse position, but rather the tile that was clicked on. -> face palm moment. This should lead to more reliable placement, no more overlapping buildings or accidentally placing stuff out of range.
[*] Fixed: You can no longer accidentally upgrade, demolish, or move buildings with a right-click or middle-click. Left-click is now the main button action.
[*] Made some improvements to the ‘move’ function so that it works more reliably.
[*] Fixed: Biofuel bots will 100%-most-definitely ignore the lowest crop that’s available in your inventory (unless they have no other choice)
[*] Added: Removed the strange computer from peoples farms. It will spawn when you create a new farm but it is now treated as a decoration so that means you can demolish it if you’d like. (This should also help people trigger the Architect achievement)
[*] Added: You can now inspect berry bushes, no more guessing which ones you have already planted.
[*] Added: Berry bushes now also appear under Pinion’s statistics tab.
[*] Added: [strike]Splunk now ignores giant crops, and Slate who might be digging up a fossil on an otherwise completely empty crop patch.[/strike]
[*] Fixed: After using the demolish function in the bees tab, clicking to place a bush maintains the bulldozer icon.
[*] Added: When focus mode is enabled, in other words, when crop/biofuel production time is doubled, the crop growth times will also double in the UI window that pops up when hovering over a crop.
[/list]
I just wanted to quickly clarify that the ‘black screen bug fix’ actually fixes the game for people who couldn’t interact with it in any shape or form. You may occasionally encounter a black screen, and if the game is responsive, restarting should fix the issue. We’ve noticed that if the game is not in focus when it loads then it might not trigger the transparency correctly. We’re working on fixing this too but at least players can now interact with the game!

Thank you!

notes.title: 1.0.11 - Black screen fix (?)
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We might have found a permanent solution to the black screen bug which was making the game non-interactable for some players - this thing has been haunting me for days now.

The temporary fix was to disable fullscreen optimizations on the exe file. As expected, most players didn't know what was causing the issue and just closed the game (potentially forever). I tried my best to communicate the temporary fix in the forums and updates, but to be fair it's not the player's job to check these all the time.

[h3]SOLUTION: We've added a small script that will run and add this option for you before the game is opened![/h3]

That means we had to enable a setting on Steam's side to install .NET 4.7.2 before running the script/game. When the pop-up from 'Steam Client Service' appears please [b]click yes[/b] allowing Steam to add the changes. 

After that, you will see Steam running the install script for Microsoft .NET before opening the game (this might take a short while but don't worry it should only happen once).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/391f04385e7f2c2f1da5262a752a60020ec0d853.png[/img]

After that, you should be good to go!

I hope that this is the end of the dreaded bug, but I will be keeping a close eye on the Steam forums for any issues. Thank you!


[hr][/hr]
Edit: I should clarify that the biggest issue with this bug was that the game was [b]completely unresponsive[/b] for a lot of players. Now you might still get a black screen but if the game is interactable then you should be able to restart to fix the problem.

We've noticed that a black screen appears if you click onto another application while the game is loading. I'm still looking into fixing this issue, but for now, players that were having problems can at least interact with the game.

[hr][/hr]

A big thank you to NauM, a professional Unity Developer! We've partnered up to work on more technical issues like these, and he has been a huge help over the last few days. ːorange_heartː

Hey folks,

Here are some tweaks that have been made to the game. Hopefully, it will ease some balancing issues and frustrations.

[list]
[*] Splunk no longer wanders off the screen.
[*] Splunk will wander around less if there is work to be done.
[*] Splunk also received a bit of a speed boost + 25%
[*] Feeder bots were still causing a lot of frustration among players, so they will now take the lowest crop that is available in your inventory.

[b]Idea: [/b]
Splunk currently seeds a crop patch if it is entirely empty. I was thinking of changing it to > Splunk will seed a crop patch that is half empty. Let me know what you think!

Thank you for all your continued support! :orange_heart:

notes.title: Build 1.0.9
notes.content:
[h2]If you are experiencing a black screen and restarting doesn't help, please follow this step-by-step guide on how to fix it: [url=https://imgur.com/a/7LOAktG]https://imgur.com/a/7LOAktG[/url][/h2]

This part of the code has remained untouched since launch but there has been a sudden influx of people experiencing no transparency since yesterday.

----

Hey folks,

Apologies for the rollback yesterday, 1.0.8 was live for 1.5 hours, and people were immediately reporting issues with the transparent background, so we rolled back to the previous 1.0.7 build. For now, I’ve removed the performance improvements with the transparent background until we figure out what’s causing the issues.

[list]
[*] [strike]Improved performance for bigger resolution / high refresh rate monitors.[/strike] We’ve updated Unity to a much newer version (2022 LTS) [strike]and we’ve removed some unnecessary computing tasks around how the transparency was being drawn. Please let me know how this works, it might not be perfect but it should be a lot better.[/strike]
[*] Credited the people who spent three whole days helping me with this issue!
[*] [strike]With the improved performance implementation,[/strike] some of the UI elements had to be shuffled around.
[*] Save file improvements! After talking with the folks who made the save file plugin, we have improved the code, added checks to catch errors, and lastly added automatic backups which will load if the original file is corrupted.
[*] The new save code only writes once to the file when needed so hopefully power outages and sudden crashes will no longer affect save files. While I cannot restore previously corrupted files, I hope this update will prevent files from being wiped in the future.
[*] In-game timer should now update correctly and according to real-time. Previously it would either go faster or slower than real time depending on the frame rate set in the graphics settings.
[*] The first piece of the blocked land on the right side is now actually blocked lol.
[*] Previously, saving while Rusty was clearing a piece of land would lock that piece of land when loading the game back up. This should be fixed now!
[*] Restarting the game should automatically detect your monitor's resolution and set the game to that resolution. Before you had to physically press R or T to reset the camera/resolution.
[*] Added more checks for achievements like 10 Million Spare Parts, 1 Million Biofuel, 1 Million Watered Crops, and 1 Million Harvested Crops. There are now 3 different places in the game that can trigger these achievements (on every load) so hopefully they will work more consistently.
[*] Speaking of 1 Million Harvests, I have decided to lower the achievement down to 250,000 Harvests. This was a miscalculation on my part and to me 1 Million seems a little too far out of reach. Running the game for days on end is not fun - especially when the game’s content does not currently match the hours needed to reach those numbers. I think lowering it to 250k still makes it a grindy-idle achievement but it doesn’t outstay its welcome.
[/list]
What I hope to tackle next:
[olist]
[*] Performance on high-refresh rate monitors
[*] Balancing patch for bees, butterflies, and berry bushes. Currently, how they behave is too confusing and not very reliable.
[*] Adding more quality-of-life features and content!
[/olist]
Thank you! I was supposed to make a week 1 recap today but that will have to wait until tomorrow now ːorange_heartː

notes.title: Build 1.0.7
notes.content:
This one is only a short one because I’ve mainly spent the day investigating the hi-res / high refresh rate monitor issue with some developer friends (more on that below).

[list]
[*] Fixed: Some houses were unmoveable because sometimes another collider would block the ability to click and select the house. Now no colliders are blocking this action so it should work as intended.
[*] Fixed: You can no longer upgrade a building that is still being built which would cause Echo to get stuck.
[*] Fixed: Steam cloud saves for Mac.
[*] Not entirely sure about this one because I couldn’t replicate it on my end but people have reported that connecting to Twitch could be creating an infinite loop in the code. I’ve added a 5-second buffer between connecting and checking whether the game is still connected to Twitch. It’s a bit of a shot in the dark but hopefully it’ll keep the game from crashing.
[*] Added: Crop/building information panels now move to the right when setting the vertical farm to the left side of the screen. Zooming is still a bit wonky but I hope this helps in the meantime!
[/list]

Regarding performance issues on hi-res monitors, we’ve spent the entire day testing and looking into different potential causes, and we’ve narrowed it down to two or three things that look promising. This week we will continue with testing and we will try to get it fixed!

It seems like the issue is easily replicated on high refresh rate monitors (i.e. 144hz), so I would appreciate it if you could send me your specs here in the thread so that we can identify a common pattern. For now, some people have reported that lowering the frame rate and setting the on-demand rendering to 3 helps.

Thank you so much! :orange_heart:

notes.title: Build 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hey folks,

More fixes and improvements are on their way!

[list]
[*] Feeder bots will look at your inventory and choose between the 3 lowest crops available. This should help push out low-level crops from your inventory, and that way biofuel bots are more likely to use better crops. Biofuel bots choose at random to evenly distribute crops.
[*] Added an extra check for the Play for 1hr/24hr/48hr achievement.
[*] Moving a house, saving, and then reloading would lock their respective features. Now when moving a house, it should keep the features you’ve unlocked.
[*] Fixed random individual crops from never getting watered! Thank you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2666510/discussions/0/4357871761803076039/]ArtificialColors[/url] for finding out how to reproduce this one because I had been scratching my head all weekend.
[*] If you moved a bot, the game would think that you demolished it and as a result, their upgrade cost would be reduced (which is expected behavior for demolishing, just not for moving). Now, moving a bot doesn’t affect the upgrade price.
[*] Updated “How does Splunk work?” Help description.
[*] You can now use the middle mouse button to drag the camera around while moving or building without it triggering the placement.
[*] Pressing “R” should resize the game to your monitor. I have also added an alternative shortcut “T” which does the same thing but this code checks other monitor parameters. If the game is locked into some weird resolution, please try using these two shortcuts.
[*] Biofuel converters should now complete regardless of their visual indicator, hopefully, this will stop biofuel converters from getting stuck.
[*] Slate will now dig more fossils!
[/list]

Lastly, I would like to highlight a known issue with [b]high-resolution monitors[/b], for some unknown reason, when using a hi-res monitor the game uses a lot of resources. For now, please try playing around with the graphics settings by lowering the frame rate and setting on-demand rendering to 3 - a few people have reported that this helps.

Tomorrow I am meeting with some tech-savvy developer friends to have a closer look into the issue!

Thank you for your patience in the meantime!

notes.title: Build 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Here are a few more fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed unlocking the last crop in the list.
[*] Adjusted some colors in the Blossom Forest map to better match the vibe.
[*] Fixed decoration prices.
[*] Feeder bots will now prioritize low-level crops and ignore berries.
[*] Fixed an issue where fertilizer bots after a while would only fertilize one crop tile and return to base to recharge.

Now you can check if there is a backup (.bac) and copy-paste its contents over. Also, please mark this folder as safe in your Antivirus to prevent it from happening in the future:

Paste this into Run: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/MisterMorrisGames/Rusty's Retirement/ to find the folder

[*] I accidentally gave giant golden pumpkins a 100% spawn rate, this change was only live for 10 minutes before being reverted, so I hope it didn't affect many people 🤞
[/list]
Thank you!


[b]Build 1.0.5[/b] - Fixed animals magically converting into cows when saving/loading. This only happened if you moved a feeder that already had animals occupying it. Unfortunately, this fix only applies to future savefiles and it doesn't fix past savefiles.

notes.title: Build 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Thank you for the incredible launch so far! As expected, a few issues have come up, and I've made some quick fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed the maxed bot achievements. They were triggering when simply building a bot for the first time.
[*] Fixed the blocked lands on the right side. Previously, they would load in already unlocked.
[*] Fixed the non-pixel font on the blocked lands and house buttons.
[*] Fixed an issue with loading save files. They occasionally got stuck on trying to load buildings with no animals. This only happened if a feeder was previously built in the exact same location.
[*] Fixed an issue where if you had the move option selected and Rusty completed a task of moving another building, the move option would disable and act weirdly. It should behave as expected now.

notes.title: Rusty's Retirement is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey folks, happy launch day!

I wanted to quickly go over some of the things that have changed or been added to the game since the demo release back in February. I think you will like what's in store!

[h2]Giant crops[/h2]

Giant crops have a random chance of spawning on your farm. You can decide to keep them as decoration or you can harvest them by clicking on them multiple times. Just be careful when moving crop patches because it will delete any crops that are planted on the patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/2f672ec86b97d5e3b5836897b49c1ec1a65bdc2e.gif[/img]

[h2]Moving buildings[/h2]

That brings me to the next point, moving buildings! This was probably the biggest piece of feedback that I received from the demo. Now you can select a building to move, it will turn back into boxes, and Rusty will help move the boxes to their new location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/116e7f43fd8f5c1339aa9d5e6bfd5aeb0e4cfb41.gif[/img]

[h2]Splunk, our Savior[/h2]

Splunk will help plant seeds around the farm which is really useful in the late-game when you have a big spralling farm. If there is no sign posted, they will randomly pick one of your recently unlocked crops and seed an entire crop patch.

[h2]Vertical mode[/h2]

You can create vertical farms which are stored in separate savefiles (which are also uploaded to Steam Cloud). This was another big one from the list of demo feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/34a54bd877167837a52300f6ed46635584a4ede7.png[/img]

[h2]Priority List[/h2]

The last big piece of feedback from the demo was 'I wanna control what Rusty works on!' After upgrading a few of your robot helpers, Rusty kinda falls off, so now you can control their priorities on a more granular level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767508/4318781a6fc1b4281f73e506d65abeee27b3a14f.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
This is just a short list of a few of the things that have been added, there are also animals that 'produce' [b]fertilizer, beekeeping, and different unlockable maps![/b]

Oh, and I added in farm statistics like 2 days before launch lol

[hr][/hr]
[h3]I hope you enjoy the game, it's been really fun to make, and I can't wait to see what the community thinks![/h3]

If you'd like to support further development of the game (and future games) then please consider checking out the Supporter Pack which gives Rusty a nice golden/sparkling skin ːorange_heartː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943560/Rustys_Retirement__Supporter_Pack

notes.title: Demo build 0.2.9
notes.content:
Hey folks, thank you for playing Rusty's Retirement so far! Here are a few quick fixes to some bugs that were found in the demo:
[list]
[*] Auto-save has been added and the game will pause to save every 15 minutes unless disabled.
[*] Always on top fix on Mac.
[*] I couldn’t reproduce the black background on Mac, but I have added an extra check to see if it helps solve the issue. If the issue persists, try closing the demo and reopening it again - this seems to work for most Mac users.
[*] Player log should collect fewer actions.
[*] In some specific cases, buildings would persist after demolition. Now that shouldn’t be the case.
[*] Rusty or Haiku would get permanently stuck on a building if it was demolished while they were working on it. For now, they will still try to finish the building but it just won’t spawn at the end (note to self: this needs reworking in the future)
[*] Transparent text sometimes appears on computers/monitors with anti-aliasing enabled. For now, please disable anti-aliasing and I will look for a more permanent fix in the meantime.
[/list]
The 3 biggest pieces of feedback:
[olist]
[*] Yo, let me move my house
[*] Yo, let me control Rusty’s priority
[*] And yo, let me play vertically!
[/olist]
I’ve noted your feedback and I will make sure to include these for the full release.

Thank you so much for playing! The response has been nothing short of amazing and it makes me really happy to see so many people enjoy the game. Fun fact, this started off as a bit of a joke amongst friends and now it's turned into something pretty cool ːorange_heartː

[hr][/hr]
Please keep the feedback and suggestions coming, you guys have some absolutely amazing ideas, and I look forward to diving back into development to add them!

notes.title: Public demo available from February 2nd!
notes.content:
[h2]Rusty's Retirement will have a free playable demo![/h2]

I'm happy to announce that a public demo will be available starting Friday, [b]February 2nd[/b] - a few days before the start of Steam's NextFest!

This is a key milestone in the game's development, and I look forward to collecting your feedback. I want to make the best game possible so please let me know your comments and suggestions via the [b]in-game feedback form[/b] (found in the Settings).

I'm excited because this is an unusual game and I encourage you to try it out while playing other demos from the festival.

The demo is available for PC and Mac, and it is translated into multiple languages as well.
